articles.title: Bromley 0-2 AFC Wimbledon: Hosts' woes continue with home defeat to Dons
articles.summary: AFC Wimbledon won 2-0 victory at Bromley in Sky Bet League One; a goal in either half from Jaydon Stockley and Myles Hippolyte saw the Dons to the win; the result meant a third successive defeat for Andy Woodman's team
articles.body:
A goal in either half from Jaydon Stockley and Myles Hippolyte was enough to seal all three points and inflict a third successive defeat on Andy Woodman's team.

The Dons took the lead in the eighth minute with their first meaningful effort on goal. James Tilley's teasing cross was headed powerfully into the net by Jayden Stockley.

Dan Sweeney came close to doubling the lead eight minutes before the interval but his shot was blocked on the line via Owen Mason and George Saville.

In first-half time added on, Steven Sessegnon struck the ball into the side-netting.

It was more of the same in the second half when Stockley planted his free header straight at Mason.

Bromley sprung to life just after the hour mark, with Kamil Conteh seeing his volley from 20 yards well saved by Josef Bursik.

However that was as good as it got for the Ravens and the visitors sealed the win midway through the second half when Myles Hippolyte broke away to finish low beyond Mason - the 14th goal Bromley have conceded in 10 days.

articles.title: Man Utd 4-0 Sabah: Winning return to Champions League as Benjamin Sesko scores again for Michael Carrick's side
articles.summary: Report as Man Utd beat Sabah FC 4-0 at Old Trafford in the Champions League; first-half goals from Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes and Benjamin Sesko took the game away from their opponents before Lisandro Martinez made it four after the break
articles.body:
The Azerbaijani side started brightly but Matheus Cunha converted Patrick Dorgu's 27th-minute cross and, although Joy-Lance Mickels should have levelled, two goals late in the first half from Bruno Fernandes and Benjamin Sesko put United in total control.

Michael Carrick made changes in the second half with the points secure but there was still time for Lisandro Martinez to smash home from close range after some flashy play from Joshua Zirkzee, who produced an eye-catching cameo. Signs of that United swagger.

With goal difference a potentially significant factor in the league phase of this Champions League format, this was a fine night's work on their return. It is Atletico Madrid away next in Europe but there are bigger matters to attend to before that.

It is over 1000 days since United competed in a Champions League game but this, their 300th in Europe's premier club competition, was not too taxing for Carrick's men. It will be tougher against rivals Manchester City on Sunday - but so will his team selection.

Some of the calls are obvious. Fernandes starred again and the sight of him combining with the equally intelligent Youri Tielemans for United's second was encouraging. The Belgian produced perhaps his best 45 minutes at Old Trafford. But others pressed their case too.

Sesko scored after coming off the bench against Everton and looked sharp here in his first start of the season. With Marcus Rashford also available, and Cunha getting a confidence-boosting goal, there are some interesting decisions ahead for the United boss.

Dorgu enjoyed himself at left-back with Luke Shaw missing from the squad but he was able to play as a de facto winger given United's superiority. It will be more challenging against City's attack but Carrick and his players go into that with confidence restored.

27 - GOAL! Cunha converts Dorgu's cross at the near post

36 - SITTER! Mickels nods wide from inside the six-yard box

42 - GOAL! Fernandes makes it two from Tielemans' pass

45 - GOAL! Mbeumo puts Sesko in to round the goalkeeper

68 - GOAL! Zirkzee's backheel finds Martinez who smashes it in

Man Utd boss Michael Carrick speaking in the press conference:

"I think it was kind of what we set out to achieve, good performance, individually and collectively throughout the game, the boys that started, the boys that came on pitch, clean sheet, goals, exciting football. A good night all round.

"Results-wise, it has not been the start that what we wanted. We wanted more points in the league. But performance-wise, it has been a lot of things we are looking for.

"Collectively, as a team, we have done a lot of the right things and that is why were are excited about what the season will bring. It is really encouraging for me."

"He definitely offers a different kind of threat, that is the beauty of it really, we know what Ben gives us and there are not many who can give us what he gives us. Speed, physicality, ability to play on the last line and run in behind. Great to have him back."

Sabah head coach Valdas Dambrauskas speaking in the press conference:

"I didn't feel like we were shaking or scared, we tried to play, for the whole 90 minutes we did that. We were escaping from time to time from United pressure.

"We will all go home thinking we could have done better, especially the result. The result could have been a little bit smaller.

"We did not have enough courage probably from the back line to get up. Our centre-backs stayed too deep, not afraid but maybe from inexperience we were over-evaluating the opponent.

"Because when you don't squeeze that space and you allow those players to turn and run it is almost impossible to stop them."

articles.title: James Taylor aims to make Wales a force in deaf football
articles.summary: Having transitioned from player to head coach, James Taylor plans to make Wales a force to be reckoned with in deaf football.
articles.body:
Wales and England come face-to-face in Llandarcy on Friday, 11 September, the latest chapter in the rollercoaster story of the Wales Deaf men's football side.

Re-established in 2023, they drew with England and beat both Scotland and Ireland in their first three matches.

However, from such a promising start the Wales Deaf Football Association (WDFA) found themselves going backwards.

In 2024 the squad travelled to Turkey, full of hope for the EuroDeaf Championships but lost all four of their group games.

A review led to a change of the organisation's backroom staff structure and the appointment of a new head coach, former Wales Deaf forward James Taylor.

Despite a 7-1 hammering by England in his first game in charge, Taylor has big plans for Wales - and knows all about dealing with the ups and downs football can throw at you, for 'Jamo' has quite the story himself.

Taylor was an experienced Welsh league player who once aspired to be a professional, but total deafness in his left ear prevented him from reaching his potential.

"It's probably one of the reasons that let me down in the professional world, because anything that was coming to the left-hand side, I didn't hear," Taylor said.

"I started grassroots football for the local team, Afan Lido. I was fortunate to be in a successful team from the age of eight to 16.

"We won everything that was possible for us."

Taylor's goal for the under-16 team against Swansea City caught the eye of Swansea scouts and he later spent two years in the Vetch Field club's youth training scheme.

Taylor's youth team manager at Swansea was retired Wales forward Alan Curtis, who he described as a "legend and a gentleman".

"I grew up in a Swansea sporting household. My father was a massive Swansea City supporter," Taylor recalled.

"I was born in the morning and he was on the North Bank in the afternoon watching the Swans. His idol was Alan Curtis, so that just made my father proud as punch.

"When we went to places like Cheltenham and Bristol, we'd normally stop off and pick up my old man, and you can imagine him in a minibus with Alan Curtis driving - he chewed the ear off him!"

Taylor made a single senior appearance for Swansea, against Haverfordwest in the West Wales Senior Cup in the 1997-98 season.

But a serious ankle injury thwarted his second season and he was subsequently told he would not be taken on as a professional.

"They did reassure me that if I went to any team and carried on scoring goals, they'd put me back in and keep looking at me, but unfortunately, those goals died away," said Taylor.

He returned to Afan Lido before stints at Port Talbot, Neath and Goytre. Then at the age of 43, Taylor won the first of three caps for Wales Deaf men's team.

In February 2026 Taylor took charge of his first match, facing England at the FA's training headquarters, St George's Park.

But Wales' visit proved a sharp lesson, with that 7-1 defeat.

"It hurt, and I believe it hurts harder as a manager. However, it provided a valuable benchmark for where we are as a squad," Taylor said.

As part of the re-building process, a talent identification day was held at Dragon Park in Newport in June, which saw more than 20 new players attend.

"It was a real success with a great turnout. There are a few new faces coming in, as well as a couple of familiar faces from old returning," he added.

"The standard of football was good, the players took on board the information really well, and their attitudes and commitment were excellent."

Wales - like England - are hoping to send a squad to compete in the inaugural Deaf International Football Association Deaf Football World Cup in Australia in November 2027, and then six months later to the 2028 European Deaf Football Championships in Italy.

So, for Taylor, their schedule leading up to the tournaments needs to be filled with as many matches as possible.

"We're not going to be going camp, camp, camp... it's only in a game when you can really see the development in the boys and the squad," he said.

They recently played a friendly against Newport Corinthians, who play in the third tier of the Welsh pyramid, losing 6-4.

"The thing that stood out for us against them was that our boys haven't had those minutes in their legs, where Newport Corries I'm sure have had a good pre-season," said Taylor.

He also knows the international against England in Llandarcy on Friday (19:30 BST) will be another big step up.

"We need to start making waves and noises," he said.

"I haven't taken on this management role just to post a load on social media. My hopes are to make Wales a force in deaf football.

"I'm only interested in the players who are 100% committed to Wales now.

"I'm not saying they haven't in the past, but maybe seeing a bit more competition coming into camp will give them that push, not only for Wales, but in their personal football journeys as well.

"That's all I ever want to do is make the players the best version of themselves on a football pitch."

articles.title: El Barcelona aspira al trono
articles.standfirst: Bwin iguala al conjunto azulgrana con el PSG y el Arsenal en lo más alto de las quinielas
articles.summary: Bwin iguala al conjunto azulgrana con el PSG y el Arsenal en lo más alto de las quinielas
articles.body: Hasta hace apenas unas semanas, el PSG figuraba en solitario como máximo favorito para revalidar el título de la Champions League, apoyado en su condición de vigente campeón y en la solidez mostrada durante toda la pasada temporada. Sin embargo, el arrollador inicio de curso del Barcelona ha obligado al mercado de casas de apuestas a replantearse por completo sus previsiones, hasta el punto de que el conjunto de Hansi Flick ya comparte el trono de las apuestas deportivas. Los números del Barcelona en este inicio de campaña resultan difíciles de discutir. El conjunto azulgrana, además de liderar la clasificación en el primer tramo de LaLiga, ha anotado cinco goles o más en tres encuentros y trasladó esa misma contundencia a su debut europeo con una goleada por 5-1 ante el Feyenoord en el Spotify Camp Nou, con Raphinha como gran protagonista al firmar un doblete apenas tres días después de quedarse fuera de la lista corta del Balón de Oro. El equipo de Flick dominó de principio a fin ante los neerlandeses, con un 67% de posesión y 22 disparos totales por solo 5 del rival, cifras que reflejan la superioridad manifiesta mostrada en las últimas semanas. Ese nivel de juego ha bastado para que Bwin mueva con fuerza su mercado de campeón de la Champions League. La casa de apuestas paga ahora a cuota 6 tanto la conquista del título por parte del Barcelona como por parte del PSG y el Arsenal, los tres colocados en lo más alto de las quinielas. Se trata de un movimiento significativo, ya que hasta ahora el conjunto parisino, campeón vigente, aparecía como referencia única del mercado, mientras que el Barcelona ha ido escalando puesto tras puesto gracias a su regularidad goleadora y a la solidez defensiva mostrada en paralelo. Por detrás de este trío de favoritos aparece el Bayern de Múnich, a cuota 7, un equipo que en las últimas temporadas se ha convertido en un habitual de las rondas decisivas del torneo. Le sigue el Real Madrid, a cuota 8, pese a las dudas generadas en su último compromiso europeo ante el Inter, y cierra este grupo de perseguidores el Manchester City, a cuota 10, con Erling Haaland como principal argumento ofensivo del conjunto de Enzo Maresca. Con este panorama, el Barcelona afronta la temporada con la doble ambición de revalidar el título de LaLiga, donde también es máximo favorito, y de pelear de tú a tú por la Champions League, competición que no levanta desde 2015. La profundidad de su plantilla, con jugadores como Lamine Yamal, Pedri o el recién llegado Gabriel Jesús aportando desde el banquillo, invita a pensar que el proyecto de Flick tiene argumentos de sobra para sostener este nivel a lo largo de toda la temporada.

articles.title: The signs are trending upwards for one Manchester City player but one moment may spark the fuse
articles.summary: As Manchester City beat FC Porto 2-0 on Tuesday night to begin their UEFA Champions League campaign on the right foot a host of players played well at the Es...
articles.body:
As Manchester City beat FC Porto 2-0 on Tuesday night to begin their UEFA Champions League campaign on the right foot a host of players played well at the Estádio do Dragão. One of those was Phil Foden . Foden played a crucial role in City's opening goal and he put in a lively display before he was taken off in the 75th minute. The England international's form is trending upwards, however you do sense that once he scores a goal the proverbial shackles may be released.

Phil Foden was a handful for Manchester City against FC Porto.

It wouldn't be a stretch to say that Phil Foden put in his best performance of the season against FC Porto on Tuesday night. Foden did play well against Crystal Palace in City's 4-1 win at Selhurst Park where he registered two assists. However, in terms of overall impact, Foden's display at the Estádio do Dragão was probably the more impactful performance.

Phil Foden should have registered an assist in the first half against FC Porto when he set up a great chance for Erling Haaland with a quality cross from the left. However, Diogo Costa kept out Haaland's header. He also saw a shot saved from the right by Diogo Costa that perhaps Foden could have hit better. Foden's pass to set up Manchester City's opening goal against Francesco Farioli's side was absolutely sublime. It was a snapshot of Foden's tremendous quality as a player.

Overall, Foden played an important role for Manchester City in their 2-0 win over FC Porto. He looks to have his spark back. Having said that, there is one aspect of Foden's play that, if it arrives, may release the shackles so to speak.

Foden does look like he needs to score a goal to release the shackles.

Phil Foden has not scored for Manchester City in 34 matches. His last goal came in City's 3-2 win over Leeds United where he bagged a brace in City's win on December 14, 2025. Given Foden's quality as a player and a finisher, that is an absurd statistic. Foden is finishing like a player who desperately needs a goal. That has stood out this season.

Foden missed two great chances in City's 4-1 win over Crystal Palace. He also squandered a great chance last weekend against Coventry City. Phil Foden looks like he needs a goal and you do sense that when he finally hits the back of the net, he may kick on to build on his recent good performances.

Phil Foden has shown enough evidence that he is playing well so far this season. He was very good in Manchester City's win over FC Porto earlier this week. However, it does seem like Phil Foden needs a goal to release the shackles and spur him on. If it can come this Sunday against Manchester United , it could be the moment that ignites Foden's season so to speak.

articles.body:
Fenerbahçe returned to football's biggest stage, the Champions League, after 18 years. After a fairly solid opening draw against Roma, a memorable press conference followed. Fener coach Ismail Kartal announced his resignation completely out of the blue. Clearly and without speaking to his players beforehand. One of them, Archie Brown, was caught off guard by the news live during a TV interview.

"What do you mean he resigned?" the 24-year-old asked several times in disbelief. The decision is final. Who will take over on the Fenerbahçe bench remains unclear for now.

articles.title: Manchester United beat Sabah 4-0 on Champions League return
articles.summary: Goals from Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes, Benjamin Sesko and Lisandro Martinez seal a winning UCL return for United.
articles.body:
Manchester United returned to the Champions League in style with a 4-0 league phase win against competition debutants Sabah of Azerbaijan.

Three-time winners United were making their first appearance in Europe’s most elite club tournament in three seasons and stormed into a three-goal lead at the break in Thursday’s match thanks to goals by Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes and Benjamin Sesko.

The home side rounded off the victory in the second half through Lisandro Martinez, but it was not completely free of anxiety.

It had been a slow start by United, which drew some minor groans from the Old Trafford faithful, but any nerves settled once Cunha tapped in Patrick Dorgu’s low cross in the 27th minute.

There was an alarming moment later, for the home side, when Kaheem Parris drove into the box before standing up a perfect cross to Joy-Lance Mickels, who should have made no mistake with his header, but nevertheless failed to score.

United captain Fernandes, who was among the candidates for the 2026 Ballon d’Or award, netted the second after a passing move that showed the growing confidence in the home side.

Sesko was sent through for the third on the stroke of half-time, and the Slovakian forward rounded the keeper – resisting the temptation to go down for a penalty – before slotting home from a tight angle.

Cunha went close to his second, and United’s fourth, on the hour mark, but his curled effort from the edge of the box was too close to the keeper. Fernandes failed with a similar effort mere seconds later.

The pace in the second period had eased, however, and the fourth did not arrive until Martinez tapped in on the goal line after a scramble in the box following a corner.

There was a final chance for Sabah to take a goal away from Old Trafford, but Parris drilled a late, low effort across the goal when he should have at least tested the keeper.

It was a night in which United manager Michael Carrick was able to rotate some of his bigger names, although only three changes were made to the side that drew 2-2 at Everton on Sunday.

With this Sunday’s Manchester derby on their minds, the Red Devils took advantage of the scoreline to ring the second-half changes – using all five substitutions with more than 20 minutes remaining.

The result, in one of the biggest mismatches in Champions League history, does not paper over the cracks seen in the return of just four points from United’s first three Premier League games.

Any existing inadequacies will still be exposed when their cross-city rivals arrive on Sunday.

articles.title: ¡Cómo juega el Como!
articles.standfirst: El equipo de Cesc Fàbregas debuta en Champions con un gran triunfo ante el RB Leipzig
articles.summary: El equipo de Cesc Fàbregas debuta en Champions con un gran triunfo ante el RB Leipzig
articles.body: Y llegó el día. Por primera vez en sus más de 100 años de historia, el Como debutaba en competición europea. Y lo hizo siendo fiel a su seña de identidad... y cuajando un muy buen encuentro ante un ya experimentado Leipzig. Baturina fue el MVP con gol y asistencia, Douvikas (ex Celta) y Diao (ex Betis) también anotaron... y Nico Paz dejó dos asistencias. Fàbregas, mientras, sonreía en el banquillo: su forma de ver el fútbol ya trasciende fronteras. La puesta en escena del Como 1907 de Cesc en Champions no pudo ser mejor. Por primera vez en su historia, el equipo lombardo jugaba en competición europeoa... y lo hacía entrando por la puerta grande: directamente a la Liga de Campeones. Y su fútbol, sin duda, era de Copa de Europa. Al descanso ya ganaban 2-0 a un RB Leipzig que apenas tuvo un par de ocasiones aisladas. El dominio era absoluto de los italianos y a la orilla del lago Como, se presentaban al mundo. El 1-0 lo hizo Baturina, con el croata recortando sobre una baldosa y superando a Vandevoordt con clase. Poco antes del descanso, fue de nuevo Baturina el que se inventó un pase de escándalo para dejar a Douvikas ante la meta del Leipzig. Y el griego, que le aguantó el pulso a Lukeba, no falló en la definición. Un 2-0 al descanso que mostraba todo lo que es este Como de Cesc: control, juventud, desparpajo, desequilibro y talento, mucho talento. Luis Milla y Da Cunha dirigían desde la medular mientras que Nico Paz, Baturina y Diao quebraban a un Leipzig a merced de los locales. Tras un doblete ante el Genoa el pasado viernes, Assene Diao volvió a ver portería. Cuando más sufría el Como, en un buen inicio de segunda parte de los germanos, el senegalés destrozó a los germanos al contragolpe. Y tuvo el equipo de Cesc el 4-0 inmediatamente después, pero incomprensiblemente Da Cunha perdonó casi a puerta vacía. Encontró un poco de aire el Leipzig a través de un golazo que se inventó Maksimovic y el partido entró en una fase de intercambio que dejó ocasiones clarísimas para ambos bandos. Baku, el propio Nico Paz... pero al argentino le tocaba asistir hoy. Entregó el 4-1 a Perrone y firmó doblete de pases de gol. El Como y el Giuseppe Sinigaglia celebraban por todo lo alto un estreno europeo que pasará a la historia.

articles.title: El Bayern abusa del Bodo en una segunda parte colosal con una 'Manita'
articles.standfirst: El equipo noruego resistió el 0-0 en la primera... pero el Bayern exhibió su máquina luego
articles.summary: El equipo noruego resistió el 0-0 en la primera... pero el Bayern exhibió su máquina luego
articles.body: Cuando el Bayern se pone... es una máquina de hacer goles. Y así lo hizo en su debut en esta Champions que aspira a ganar. Cinco goles en la segunda mitad pusieron un abusivo 5-0 en el marcador final ante el Bodo, que sueña desde ya con la 'Orejona'. Eso sí, la primera mitad estuvo marcada por el extraordinario entramado defensivo propuesto por el técnico Knutsen en el equipo del Círculo Polar. 11 jugadores por detrás de la pelota para intentar, y conseguir, que los artistas del Bayern, que son muchos y variados, no filtraran pases ni remates. Y lo consiguió, yéndose al descanso con un 0-0 pese al remate en el palo de Kimmich, un disparo peligroso de Musiala... y poco de Harry Kane por entonces. El Bayern no pudo en los primeros 45. Tiene los mismos argumentos de la pasada temporada, en la que sólo el PSG campeón fue capaz de eliminarle en semifinales. Pero cuando los Olise, Musiala, Luis Díaz y Kane estén rodados, este equipo bávaro será de nuevo temible, cosa que ya empezó a mostrar en la segunda parte ante un, al principio, ordenado Bodo Glimt, que justificó su fama de equipo animador en Europa en los últimos años. En la pasada CL, por ejemplo, le ganó al Inter, al Atlético y empató ante el Dortmund. La resistencia del Bodo, eso sí, acabó pronto, y en el minuto 61 veía ya un 2-0 en contra merced a dos zarpazos de Jamal Musiala -el 10 del Bayern es uno de los jugadores más finos de Europa en su 'prime'- y al tanto de cada noche de Harry Kane, que en la 25-26 se ganó la Bota de Oro (¿y el Balón?) con sus 73 goles en 65 partidos con club y Selección, y en ésta... ya empieza a dar réditos para este Bayern que aspira a todo y que nadie se atreve a descartarlo como candidato a campeón. Y nadie es nadie. A partir de ahí, coser y marcar para un Bayern que jugaba con el cansancio de los noruegos para pasear cómodamente por el Allianz en el debut de esta Champions. Tan es así que Alphonso Davies, un jugador tan bueno como incomprendido a veces, y Olise, por dos veces, anotaron el 3-0, el 4-0 y el 5-0 para el delirio de unos hinchas que esperan lo máximo de este Bayern de Don Harry Kane.

articles.title: El Fenerbahçe rechaza la dimisión de su entrenador: "Soy su superior, le digo 'seguirás' y se acabó"
articles.standfirst: El presidente Aziz Yildirim no acepta la renuncia de su entrenador
articles.summary: El presidente Aziz Yildirim no acepta la renuncia de su entrenador
articles.body: El entrenador del Fenerbahce, Ismail Kartal, ha anunciado su dimisión como responsable del equipo turco tras el empate cosechado en la Liga de Campeones ante la Roma (1-1), pero el presidente de la entidad rechaza. Kartal acudió a la rueda de prensa posterior al choque en Estambul ante el Roma, de la primera jornada de la Liga de Campeones, y señaló que dejaba su cargo "con la intención de no volver nunca más". "Esta noche he dejado mi cargo", declaró Kartal en la rueda de prensa. "He tomado esta decisión para despejar el camino a mi club. Dimito con la intención de no volver nunca más. Buenas noches a todos", dijo en la sala de conferencias del estadio Chobani Stadium Fenerbahce Sukru Saracoglu de Estambul. Inesperadamente el preparador dimitió ante la sorpresa de los medios. Sin embargo, minutos después, el presidente de la entidad, Aziz Yildirim, explicó los motivos del descontento de Kartal y subrayó que rechaza la renuncia de su técnico. "Kartal seguirá en el club", dijo. "Esta noche le lanzaron una botella de agua a la cabeza del entrenador İsmail. Ésa es la razón de su dimisión", argumentó el presidente. "Por eso está triste, esa es la razón". Yildirim reconoció que no tenía noticia alguna de que el técnico tenía pensado dejar el cargo tras el choque. "No teníamos noticias de su dimisión", indicó. Y el presidente subrayó que el técnico "sigue al mando". "Ismail Kartal sigue al mando. El club debe apoyar a nuestra entrenador. Mientras yo siga de presidente y no me vaya, Kartal es el entrenador del Fenerbahce", dijo. "No hace falta que İsmail Kartal diga que seguirá. Yo soy su superior y le digo 'Seguirás' y se acabó. Entre familia pasan estas cosas. Hasta que yo no lo deje, İsmail Kartal no puede irse de aquí", insistió el presidente del Fenerbahce. El Fenerbahce inició su participación en la Liga de Campeones con un empate contra el Roma, que se adelantó seis minutos antes del descanso con el gol de Bryan Cristante. Sin embargo, el conjunto turco logró el empate al inicio de la segunda parte gracias a Archie Brown a pase de Mason Greenwood.

articles.title: Remontada final de la mano del adolescente Mesloub
articles.standfirst: El joven de 16 años cambio la cara del Lens, que jugó toda la segunda parte con uno más
articles.summary: El joven de 16 años cambio la cara del Lens, que jugó toda la segunda parte con uno más
articles.body: En superioridad numérica toda la segunda parte, de repente por detrás en el marcador cuando ya jugaba once contra diez, el Lens logró el empate en el minuto 72, se sintió perdedor con el 2-1 en el tramo final, pero se levantó y remontó bajo el influjo del talento de 16 años Meslian Mesloub y los goles de Florian Thauvin y Rubén Aguilar ya en el tiempo añadido (2-3). Una realidad ya desde la pasada temporada en el conjunto del norte francés, que compitió hasta el final por la liga contra el poderoso París Saint-Germain y se impuso en la Copa de Francia, además de ganarle la Supercopa este mismo verano, el adolescente, que el próximo 8 de noviembre cumplirá 17 años, se estrenó en la Liga de Campeones con el impacto que generan todas sus expectativas. Su reacción fue la de su equipo. Ganó al final, cuando su destino parecía la derrota, pero Mesloub centró para el testarazo magnífico de Thauvin con el que alcanzó el 2-2, ya en el minuto 91, y Rubén Aguilar, ya en el 93, soltó un fantástico derechazo raso que alojó junto al poste de la portería de Markovic. La apoteosis del Lens y el lamento del Slavia Praga, derribado al límite. Ambos saben dónde están sus opciones en esta Liga de Campeones. En partidos como éste, fuera del foco de los grandes equipos que pueblan esta fase liga entre los aspirantes a los puestos de arriba y al 'top ocho'. Por eso descargan su ambición en choques así, en los que sus posibilidades de victoria se multiplican respecto a otros. La primera parte surgió trepidante. Primero atacó sin freno el conjunto checo, tan decidido como precipitado hacia la portería contraria. Su intensidad promovió el repliegue del Lens, que soportó la ofensiva sin daño, con el susto aún en el cuerpo cuando el zurdazo de Kubiak se fue sólo por centímetros fuera del marco visitante. La réplica del Lens, en cuanto se puso a la altura de revoluciones de su oponente (o bajó la cantidad de ellas de su rival, por el paso de los minutos), la solventó Markovic por dos veces. La primera, con el cabezazo de Udol, la repelió el guardameta con su colocación. La segunda, antes del descanso, debió emplearse a fondo con una estirada magnífica. Entre medias, el Slavia Praga marcó un gol, anulado por el golpeo en la mano en el primer remate de Ayaosi, al que le benefició el rechace y anotó el tanto. Fue invalidado de inmediato. Había detectado el árbitro ya en vivo el toque en el brazo del atacante, que ya había corrido a celebrar el 1-0 que no fue tal. El 0-0 se mantuvo hasta el segundo acto. Y contra pronóstico. Porque la segunda parte empezó con la tarjeta roja a Konecny, que acaba de entrar al campo en el intermedio. En un minuto y medio, en su primera acción, derribó a Sima. La revisión del VAR invitó al colegiado al monitor, a comprobar si era o no ocasión tan manifiesta y si era el último hombre como para expulsarlo. Así lo consideró. La falta lanzada por Thauvin rozó el gol. Se marchó fuera tras sortear la barrera. Pero, de repente, fue el gol del Slavia Praga, casi en la siguiente jugada. Un zurdazo ajustado, sorpresivo, con efecto y desde el borde del área con el que Sturm batió a Risser, que sólo pudo mirar el recorrido del balón hacia la red. Era el minuto 51. Un impulso para el Slavia Praga, reconfortado en su momento más difícil. Un problema para el Lens. El conjunto francés necesitaba mucho más. La entrada de Mezian Mesloub y sus 16 años, atrevido, puro talento, le dio más dinamismo para la insistencia que exigía la obligación de marcar algún gol. Poco a poco, se acercó cada vez más al tanto, hasta que Sima estableció el 1-1 en un rechace en el enésimo rechace en el área rival. No se rindió tampoco el Slavia, pese al empate y su inferioridad numérica: dispuso de otra oportunidad clarísima, recurrió a Chory desde el banquillo e insistió en ataque, sin exponerse tampoco en exceso en su portería. Incluso marcó el 2-1, por medio de Sturm, antes de la determinación final del Lens, Mesloub. Thauvin y Rubén Aguilar. Dos goles en dos minutos. Del 91 al 93. Y Mesloub con pinta de figura en un futuro ya muy cercano.

articles.title: Nico Paz: "Era por noches como esta por las que quería quedarme en el Como"
articles.standfirst: El argentino firmó dos asistencias en el Como 4-1 RB Leipzig
articles.summary: El argentino firmó dos asistencias en el Como 4-1 RB Leipzig
articles.body: Su primer partido con el Como en Champions será inolvidable. 4-1 al RB Leipzig y dos pases de gol para Nico Paz en un Giuseppe Sinigaglia entregado al equipo de Cesc Fàbregas. Y el argentino, que jugó los 90 minutos, estaba radiante tras el pitido final. "Ha sido una noche histórica, hemos disputado un partido increíble, teníamos muchas ganas de jugar este partido y estamos muy contentos", contaba a 'Sky Italia'. El mediapunta nacido en Santa Cruz de Tenerife y ya había debutado en Champions con el Real Madrid (anotando, de hecho, al Nápoles en su segundo partido), se convirtió este verano en jugador del Como a todos los efectos (al 100%) después de que pagaran 60 millones al club blanco. Y Nico Paz tiene claro que tomó la decisión correcta, como volvió a declarar hoy: "Era por noches como esta por las que quería quedarme; sabía que aquí era donde más crecería, y estoy muy satisfecho con mi decisión. He tomado la decisión correcta".

The flashpoint came after 23 minutes when Dan Kemp burst on to a free ball and guided a lovely effort past Josh Keeley to open the scoring for Stevenage.

The Luton bench were incensed that there was no foul given on Liam Walsh by Dan Phillips during the build up, and whatever Wilshere said in response was deemed unacceptable by referee Andrew Humphries.

articles.title: Fenerbahce boss announces shock resignation after Roma draw in Champions League
articles.summary: Ismail Kartal resigns as Fenerbahce's head coach just minutes after the Turkish side's 1-1 draw with Roma in the Champions League.
articles.body:
Ismail Kartal resigned as head coach of Fenerbahce just minutes after the Turkish side's 1-1 draw with Roma in the Champions League.

Kartal made the surprise announcement in his post-match news conference, stating he plans to never return to the club he previously served as a player and assistant coach.

He came back to Fenerbahce for a fourth spell as manager in June 2026, with the club returning to the Champions League for the first time in 18 years.

Now he departs with the team sitting ninth in the Turkish Super Lig after two wins and two defeats, and after only one Champions League match.

"I have been here three months. From the beginning of the season until today, the training sessions and camps we held with the players, and the efforts of our president, have been very helpful. Those were wonderful days," Kartal said.

"As of this evening, I congratulate my players and resign from my position.

"I made this decision to pave the way for my club. We made this decision together as a team.

"From now on, to help Fenerbahce, my players and future coaches, I have resigned from my position, with the intention of never returning."

Club president Aziz Yildirim has not accepted 65-year-old Kartal's resignation.

Yildirim said in a statement released on Fenerbahce's website , external : "Ismail Kartal is still in charge. The club should support our coach. Until I leave, Ismail Kartal is the head coach of Fenerbahce."

Yildirim confirmed he spoke to Kartal following the news conference, with the coach citing "pressure" of the role and a mid-match incident where he was struck by a bottle thrown from the stands as factors in his decision.

In a post on social media, the club said a spectator involved in the bottle incident has been identified and banned from the stadium.

Yildirim criticised the attitude of the club's supporters and the media, pinpointing the "pressure" created by the constant criticism and calling for both parties to "uphold the values of the Fenerbahce community" and show greater respect to Kartal.

Doubling down on Kartal's future, he said: "This community should support Ismail Kartal. You can't show support by throwing punches at him like this.

"Ismail Kartal doesn't need to say he'll continue. I am his senior. I said he'll continue, and that's it. We're a family."

Kartal's announcement came as a shock to Fenerbahce's players, with English defender Archie Brown, whose 48th-minute equaliser cancelled out Bryan Cristante's first-half effort for Italian side Roma, completely taken aback in a post-match interview.

When informed of Kartal's resignation, Brown said: "What do you mean he resigned? As coach? He's not the coach any more? He said this just now? I didn't know about this."

Kartal won the Turkish Super Cup in 2014 during his first spell as manager, having previously spent four years as an assistant coach. As a player, he won two league titles among six trophies with the club.

articles.title: Kentucky HC Will Stein Urges Fans to 'Scream Obscenities' vs. Alabama, Wants 'Loudest' 65K Fans Ever
articles.summary: Kentucky head coach Will Stein is hoping a rowdy home crowd will welcome the Wildcats' first ranked opponent of the 2026 season.
articles.body:
Kentucky head coach Will Stein is hoping a rowdy home crowd will welcome the Wildcats' first ranked opponent of the 2026 season.

Stein said in a Thursday appearance on Kentucky Sports Radio he wants fans to end tailgates early in order to start making noise in the stadium before Saturday's kickoff against No. 12 Alabama.

"We've got to be there during pregame warmups, pack Kroger Field, and then when kickoff happens it needs to be the loudest 65,000 group of people in the history of the world," Stein said.

Report Card Grades for CFB's Top QBs 🧑‍🏫

Stein added he wants fans "standing up, screaming obscenities at our opponent, making them feel very unwanted in Kroger Field, and creating an environment of excellence for Kentucky football."

"You want to see a great product on the field? I want to see insane fans in the stands as well," Stein concluded.

Kentucky and Alabama are set to kick off in Lexington this Saturday at 3:30 p.m. ET.

Stein shared a similar message during his opening message at Tuesday's press conference.

"They've got to take off work Monday because they can't talk, that's how loud I want this place to be," Stein said Tuesday.

Stein said Thursday on KSR he felt crowd noise could have a measurable impact on Kentucky's chances of claiming the program's first win over a ranked opponent since 2024.

"It disrupts the communication from the quarterback, from the play caller, from the offensive line. Creates false starts, creates penalties, delays of game," Stein said. "The more we can get at that, the better off we're going to be."

Stein, the youngest coach in the SEC, spent three seasons as offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach for Oregon before he was hired by Kentucky last December.

He made his head coaching debut when Kentucky opened the season last Saturday with a 45-17 win over Youngtown State.

Kroger Field reported 60,166 people were in attendance for the game, below the stadium's official football capacity of 61,000.

Stein is hoping to see that number climb against Alabama, which opened its own campaign last Saturday with more than 100,000 people in attendance for a 48-10 win over visiting East Carolina.

A victory over Alabama at home this weekend would put Kentucky on upset watch for the following week, when the Wildcats continue SEC play with a road game at No. 10 Texas A&M.

articles.title: Mbappé entra en campaña
articles.standfirst: El francés quiere acelerar en la carrera por el Balón de Oro, tanto dentro como fuera del césped
articles.summary: El francés quiere acelerar en la carrera por el Balón de Oro, tanto dentro como fuera del césped
articles.body: Kylian Mbappé ha entrado en campaña por el Balón de Oro. No es el único. Tras conocerse este pasado martes la lista de los 30 finalistas, en la que figuran otros tres jugadores del Real Madrid, el internacional francés trata de acelerar en la carrera por el mayor premio individual en el mundo del fútbol. Una puja a la que, también, se han querido sumar esta semana jugadores como Lamine Yamal o Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, por citar sólo un par de ejemplos. Mbappé se reinvindicó el lunes, en la rueda de prensa previa al estreno del Real Madrid en la Champions. La elección del 10 como jugador elegido para atender a los medios pudo no ser casual, a tenor del mensaje lanzado por Kylian. "Cuando juegas para el Madrid, la gente te asocia a este premio. Mucha gente me habla del Balón de Oro, es un tema positivo, he hecho historia este verano, pero vamos a ver. Es un buen año para eso y la gente tiene que votar". Un mensaje que se une al que se emitirá de forma íntegra este fin de semana en una entrevista a France Football, coorganizador del Balón de Oro junto a la UEFA, en la que Mbappé incide en la misma idea. "Ser el máximo goleador de la historia de la Copa del Mundo, pasar por delante de todas las grandes leyendas de la historia del deporte en el torneo más importante que existe, es algo que quema la retina, un acontecimiento mundial. ¿Por quién voto? Por mí", afirma Mbappé en un adelanto de esta entrevista filtrado a los medios. La campaña por Mbappé arrancó incluso antes, y su lanzador no fue el futbolista, sino su entrenador. El pasado 28 de agosto, José Mourinho dejó una de esas largas reflexiones a las que acostumbra en esta segunda etapa en el Madrid, pidiendo, sin nombarlo de forma expresa, el Balón de Oro para el delantero parisino. "Para mí -dijo Mou-, el Balón de Oro tiene que ser para esos jugadores que, cuando se retiran, los echamos de menos para la eternidad. Echo de menos a Maradona, Ronaldo, Ronaldinho, Cristiano, Messi, Zidane, Matthäus... No puedes dar el Balón de Oro porque ganó la Champions o el Mundial. Si quieres premiar la Champions, dale el Balón de Oro a Luis Enrique como mejor entrenador. A España, seguro que De la Fuente lo merece. Esto es el gran homenaje. Otra cosa es el mejor del mundo, no tiene que ser del PSG ni de España. Son dos, tres o cuatro y sabemos quiénes son. Sabemos dónde están, aquí. Sabemos quién ha hecho historia a nivel individual este verano". Acercamiento del Madrid En un año sin favorito claro al Balón de Oro, el Real Madrid vuelve a acercarse a los promotores del premio después del tremendo desencuentro de 2024, cuando todos daban por hecho el Balón de Oro para Vinicius y el galardón recayó finalmente en Rodri, pese a que el Madrid fue campeón de Europa y España con el brasileño como gran estrella. Cuanto tuvo conocimiento de la decisión final, el mismo día de la entrega del premio, el Madrid canceló el viaje de su delegación a París, escenificando un desencuentro que ahora parece en vías de solución, tras el acercamiento entre Florentino Pérez y Aleksander Ceferin después del cisma por la Superliga. Dejando al margen la política, que siempre influye en la concesión de este galardón, los méritos deportivos de Mbappé son innegables. Fue el máximo goleador de la pasada Liga, de la Champions y del Mundial, aunque no pudo concretar esa productividad en ningún titulo. En el Mundial, además, hizo historia al convertirse en el máximo artillero de la historia del torneo (22 goles), a pesar de contar con sólo tres participaciones. Números extraordinarios que el delantero del Madrid mantiene en el arranque de la nueva temporada, en la que hasta ahora suma cinco goles en cinco partidos. En una contienda muy abierta, Mbappé se aferra a los números individuales a falta de premios colectivos que los refrenden. Voces autorizadas, como Thierry Henry, se han sumado en las últimas horas a la candidatura del galo, que selecciona sus apariciones en medios con la intención de generar consenso. La última, este pasado martes en CBS, la tercera cadena de TV más importante del mundo, poseedora de los derechos de la Champions para Estados Unidos, a la que Mbappé atendió por primera vez, en otra decisión que no parece casual. Kiki quiere meterse de lleno en la carrera por el Balón de Oro, que se presenta más abierta que nunca para el delantero del Real Madrid y Francia.

articles.summary: García Plaza ha convocado en redes al ‘manicomio’ del Sánchez-Pizjuán para prolongar la racha ante el colista, que llega sin victorias y solo un gol a favor
articles.body: sevilla y Valencia se miden este viernes (21.00 horas) en el Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán. Los andaluces, con siete de 12 puntos en este arranque liguero y buenas sensaciones, afilan el colmillo ante el equipo de Corberán, colista, sin victorias y con un solo gol a favor por nueve en contra. Cinco de ellos los encajó la pasada jornada ante el Barcelona en Mestalla, aunque los de Flick juegan otra Liga. El Sevilla no quiere resucitar a su adversario. García Plaza lleva mucho en esto del fútbol, por eso no se fía de la condición de colista cuando sólo se han jugado cuatro partidos. Sabe qué Sevilla quiere, un equipo que va a por el partido. Con siete goles a favor, quiere ser más sólido atrás. No podrá contar con Sangante, sancionado y lesionado. No está teniendo suerte en su estreno como blanquirrojo. Tampoco llega Vargas. El técnico está empeñado en recuperarle. La afición sevillista tiene muchas ganas de ver a jugadores como Stassin y Fofana. El Valencia comparece en el Sánchez-Pizjuán como colista, con un punto y un solo gol marcado en cuatro partidos. La imagen del equipo en los dos últimos partidos, ante el Deportivo y Barcelona, deja muy tocado al técnico Carlos Corberán. Además, apenas puede sumar jugadores para intentar la reacción. No se recuperaron Guido ni Rioja y la vuelta de De Haas viene forzada por la ausencia de efectivos en defensa. Tras los ocho goles encajados en los dos últimos encuentros el plan empezará por no encajar. Fofana vs. Elliott. Los astros se alinearon y José Ignacio Navarro fue muy hábil para firmar al francés. Se le notó un poco la inactividad en su debut, pero su presencia supone un salto de calidad para el centro del campo del Sevilla. articles.summary: Benjamin Sesko's return to Manchester United's starting line-up is well timed ahead of Sunday's Premier League encounter with Manchester City
articles.body:
Manchester United will experience far stiffer tests of their Champions League credentials than Sabah FK gave them at Old Trafford.

In fact, it would be no surprise if the Azerbaijani champions were by some distance the weakest of the eight league stage opponents Michael Carrick's side will come up against.

However, there were some important lessons for head coach Carrick to absorb.

The biggest of them is that United are a much more effective unit when Benjamin Sesko starts.

This was the first time the Slovenian had done that since the Liverpool game last March, when he finally accepted he could no longer play through the shin issue that had been plaguing him for a number of weeks.

It had been hoped Sesko would be fit for the start of the Premier League season.

As it turned out, he was only at the stage where he could be brought on as a substitute in the second half of the opening-day trip to Hull. The same also applied for the subsequent outings against Ipswich and Everton .

It was Sabah's bad luck that Sesko was fit to start against them – and it showed.

At 6ft 5in, the 23-year-old has a physical presence United's other strikers lack.

Amad Diallo's current absence has robbed Carrick of the option to start Bryan Mbeumo at the head of his attack, as he did during pre-season, but Matheus Cunha is not without ability in that role.

The problem is that the Brazilian likes to drift and drop back into space, which leaves a gap at the apex of Manchester United 's attack.

Sesko offers a totally different threat. He pushes defences back. He is not easy to dispossess. He runs at opponents rather than away from them.

At Everton , it was his size that allowed him to convert a close-range header that looked set to give United victory but ultimately didn't, because of Ainsley Maitland-Niles' stunning late strike.

Against Sabah FK, Sesko had threatened with an impudent first-half back-flick before Mbeumo sent him running beyond the visitors' defence.

Sesko had clarity of thought, swiftly moving the ball past goalkeeper Stas Pokatilov before steering the ball into an empty net.

"Of course, I'm happy with my goal," Sesko told TNT after the game.

"I saw him rushing out, and it was a great opportunity to take the ball away from him and make the goal a little bit easier."

United's scenario is not that Mbeumo and Cunha can't do that, it is more that Sesko can do it in addition to presenting the physical threat.

'Good control for a big man' is one of football's oldest cliches. Yet the players who can combine size with skill and pace are exceptionally useful.

"He definitely offers a different kind of threat," said Carrick.

"That's the beauty of it, really. We know what Ben gives us. There's not many around that kind of give you what Ben does in terms of his physique, his physicality, playing on the last line and his speed to run in behind. He's a real threat.

"It's great to have him back at this level after working to get his fitness back.

"A couple of goals and good performances, and good minutes in him. I'm really pleased with the way he's gone."

It is a fairly obvious thing to say but Carrick now has a big decision before Sunday's Premier League derby with Manchester City at Old Trafford.

Does he trust Sesko's fitness and stick with him? Or does he revert to Cunha, given there has been no indication Amad is ready to return.

On this evidence, Sesko should get the nod. That in turn would leave Carrick to decide whether Cunha, who opened the scoring against Sabah, or Marcus Rashford, who was an unused substitute, should start on the left.

Rashford has yet to score a goal or create one since he returned to his boyhood club after last season's loan spell at Barcelona.

However, he has been their most consistent threat with his pace and direct running.

Cunha drifts into similar positions to skipper Bruno Fernandes, and Carrick may decide United's structure works better with England international Rashford.

If that is the case, he wasn't admitting it on a night when Fernandes also scored.

"It's not an easy decision, of course it's not," Carrick said of his team selection.

"But it's definitely one I'd prefer: to have goals in the team and for the boys to be playing well.

"The understanding they all have is that sometimes it's going to be a start, sometimes it's going to be finishing the game. We need that within the group, from game to game over the season, to be able to call upon slightly different kind of things at different times.

"It's fantastic they're all in good form and started so well."

articles.title: Book: “His mood is getting better and better”

articles.body:
Ole Book on Nico Schlotterbeck 's return to team training: "Nico is making a very good impression. His mood keeps getting a little better every time he gets to play soccer again and train with the team—and that surely means he's close to getting back on the field and playing soccer in front of a crowd. That's doing him good, which is why he's making such a good impression, including in yesterday's training session. That really looked like soccer."

… when asked whether Ramy Bensebaini is ready to play again: "I'd assume so, yes. He's training well, is also making a good impression, and is fit."

… on the upcoming home game against SC Paderborn: "It's definitely going to be a tough challenge. Of course, I know Paderborn very well, just like our coaches and players, who've studied them extensively. We know how intensely Paderborn can play soccer, how hard-working they are, and what good systems they have. We're well aware that they've caused major problems for every opponent. Nevertheless, we're looking forward to a home game in the Bundesliga and want to build on our strong performance against Villarreal."

… a possible Guirassy/Silva striking duo: "I don't want to get ahead of the coach when it comes to tactical systems and formations. Of course, we talk about it, and when players perform well and make themselves available, then naturally you consider how different players fit together. But that doesn't just apply to Fabio—it also applies to other players who have performed well. Fortunately, there are a few positions where we might face some tough decisions, but that's exactly why we want to have a squad like this."

articles.title: BVB Hosts Paderborn on a High Note
articles.summary: Two wins in the Bundesliga, one in the Cup, and one in the UEFA Champions League—BVB has recently celebrated four consecutive victories. In the Bundesliga st...
articles.body:
Two wins in the Bundesliga, one in the Cup, and one in the UEFA Champions League— BVB has recently celebrated four consecutive victories. In the Bundesliga standings, the Black and Yellows sit in third place with the maximum six points. Regarding the midweek match against Villarreal CF (3-2), BVB coach Niko Kovac says: "Of course, you drain yourself physically, but also mentally. Now it's about regaining mental focus immediately so we can switch gears back to the Bundesliga." He said his team is the favorite against the newly promoted side: "We're playing at home and want to win—that's our goal." But: "There are no easy games in the Bundesliga. You have to play them in a way that puts you right in the game from the start. That's why I want my lads to come out strong from the first minute and get our fans back behind us as quickly as possible so we can play successful football."

Nico Schlotterbeck and Ramy Bensebaini have returned to team training following their injuries and are available for the Paderborn match. "They're fit, healthy, and ready to play this weekend. I can count on both of them," said Kovac. Konstantinos Karetsas will not be available; he had to be substituted during the match against Villarreal due to circulatory problems.

For the third time in its club history, SC Paderborn has been promoted to the Bundesliga. "A team that has the ambition to stay in the league. We'll certainly face a deep defensive block from an opponent looking to counterattack," said Kovac. On the first matchday, the team earned a point at FSV Mainz 05 (0–0) and then lost 0–1 at home to SC Freiburg . The team currently sits in 12th place in the standings. Despite 23 shots on goal, Paderborn hasn't scored a single goal yet. Defensively, however, they haven't conceded much and have goalkeeper Nahuel Noll to thank, who has allowed only one goal so far. Paderborn's Felix Götze (who played for BVB's youth team until 2014) and Steffen Tigges (2019–2022) have both worn the Black and Yellow jersey in the past.

BVB has never lost a competitive match against SC Paderborn: There have been two DFB-Pokal clashes, both of which saw the Black and Yellows advance to the next round. In the Bundesliga, the Borussians have won two matches so far, with two others ending in draws. The most memorable match to date was their last Bundesliga clash in late May 2020. In that coronavirus-induced game played behind closed doors in Paderborn, the Borussians had a weak first half but stepped up their game after the break. All seven goals in the 6-1 victory came in the second half. It was the highest-scoring half of the 2019-20 season. For BVB, Jadon Sancho (3), Thorgan Hazard , Achraf Hakimi , and Marcel Schmelzer —scoring his final professional goal—found the back of the net. Christina Reinke

Following the international break, Werder Bremen will visit on Friday, October 9, at 8:30 p.m. to kick off Matchday 5 of the Bundesliga. A week later, BVB will travel to Union Berlin for a Saturday afternoon showdown (October 17, 3:30 p.m.).

This will be followed by two top matches at 6:30 p.m.: against Eintracht Frankfurt (October 24) and at Bayern Munich (October 31).

Before and after the November international break, BVB will once again be in action at the traditional kickoff time of 3:30 p.m.: first at home against Elversberg (Nov. 7), then on the road at Borussia Mönchengladbach (Nov. 21). At the end of November, BVB and Bayer Leverkusen will wrap up Matchday 11 of the Bundesliga on Sunday evening (Nov. 29) at 7:30 p.m.

The next date in the DFB Cup has also been set: Today, Thursday, the DFB announced the match dates for the second round. Borussia Dortmund will face Werder Bremen at SIGNAL IDUNA PARK on October 27 at 8:45 p.m.

articles.title: UNC football vs. ETSU game preview, info, prediction and more
articles.summary: Will the North Carolina Tar Heels move to 2-0 on the young season? They host ETSU on Saturday.
articles.body:
The North Carolina Tar Heels are finally returning to the field after a week off as they have the chance to go 2-0 on the season. With all the distractions around the program, it feels like the win over TCU was ages ago.

But on Saturday, UNC will host their home opener against East Tennessee State . It's a game where UNC should win as they are multiple-touchdown favorites in this one. It's also another game where the Tar Heels can silence some critics and get this second year under the Bill Belichick era off to a good start.

With a really tough schedule ahead, this game is important in terms of UNC's bowl chances this season. Needing six wins, getting this one is key.

Just play your game. With games that are projected to be this lopsided over the years, we've seen that the longer the underdog hangs in there, the better chance they believe they have. And they can also pull an upset in the process.

For North Carolina in this game, it's simple. Play your game. The Tar Heels are the favorites for a reason and they can't let the Buccaneers hang around all game.

Will Billy Edwards Jr. get going? The quarterback wasn't awful by any means in his first start with North Carolina and he actually got off to a hot start. But he cooled off a little bit as the game went on. The coaching staff did say they were also going to give Miles O'Neill reps vs. TCU, which is something we could see against ETSU.

Getting out to a big lead and allowing the team to play both quarterbacks could help down the line.

articles.body:
As the Southeastern Conference ( SEC ) filed a lawsuit against the LSU football program for the team attempting to put on the roster and field players who had been on NFL rosters, a recent meeting took place that might've had some relevant information. While there was talk of whether the SEC would meet to expel the LSU football program from the conference, the latest statement lacks any detail on what the next steps are.

According to the latest statement from the SEC, it says that presidents and chancellors from member institutions of the conference met on Thursday, with discussions to continue as they "work toward an appropriate resolution."

"The presidents and chancellors of the Southeastern Conference met Thursday by videoconference to discuss recent matters involving conference expectations and responsibilities. Those discussions will continue as the Conference and its member universities work toward an appropriate resolution," the SEC's statement read.

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

All in all, it says there isn't a resolution on the Tigers and whether further action will be taken, with ESPN insider Pete Thamel reporting that LSU president Wade Rousse actually joined the meeting, "but only briefly" since they're under "pending federal litigation."

"LSU president Wade Rousse joined the SEC presidents and chancellors call today, but only briefly, per ESPN sources," Thamel wrote on X, formerly Twitter. "He explained to the participants that in light of the pending federal litigation, of which he and LSU are named defendants, that he was advised by council not to participate."

Rousse, head coach Lane Kiffin, and the LSU football program are listed as defendants in the lawsuit by the SEC, as it remains to be seen what happens next. The Tigers focus on following the 51-10 beatdown of Clemson as Week 2 finds the team facing Louisiana Tech on Saturday.
